title: Windows NT 3.1 MIPS on QEMU
excerpt: (This is a guest post by Antoni Sawicki aka Tenox)
content_html:
(This is a guest post by Antoni Sawicki aka Tenox)

Behold! QEMU Jazz emulator can now boot and run NT 3.1 MIPS

With high res and networking fully working!

Github: https://github.com/tenox7/qemu/tree/jazz

Ready to run image: https://tenox.pdp-11.net/os/winnt/VMs/qemu-mips/nt31mips-qemu.tar.lz
